headline: IRC Finds a Federated Future
lede: Parley lets independently operated servers speak through plain IRC while discovering one another through signed web protocols. It is a quiet experiment in making chat interoperable without a central platform or proprietary client.

headline: The Billion-Dollar Option That Stayed Unclaimed
lede: A 1993 grant of NVIDIA options became a decades-late fortune on paper. The paperwork may support the arithmetic, but time, memory, and the statute of limitations have made the windfall largely unreachable.

headline: Postgres Makes Time Zones Expensive
lede: `AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'` does more than normalize a display: it changes a zoned instant into a timezone-less timestamp. Preserve the type through calendar arithmetic, or comparisons and month boundaries can quietly go wrong.

headline: Teaching AI When To Think Slowly
lede: SOFAI divides problem solving between a fast solver and a slower deliberative one, with a metacognitive module choosing between them. The proposal treats compute as a resource to allocate according to confidence, reward, and difficulty; its evaluations remain future work.

headline: Ember-1 Cuts Reasoning Without Cutting Answers
lede: Fireworks’ Ember-1 targets the costly tail of long reasoning traces, using roughly 35–50% fewer tokens than its Kimi-derived predecessor. Early benchmark and production results suggest a specialized model can trade less internal verbosity for lower cost and latency.

headline: Google Search Forgets What Search Is For
lede: A query about a basketball meme becomes an unsolicited session of AI relationship advice. The failure is not merely strange; it shows how a retrieval tool can lose the user’s intent while confidently placing its own interpretation first.

headline: Nissan Reworks the Series Hybrid
lede: Nissan’s third-generation e-POWER keeps the wheels electric while an onboard engine generates the electricity. A consolidated five-in-one electric unit, steadier engine operation, improved cooling, and shared EV components aim to make the compromise more efficient and easier to build.

headline: Prompting Opus 5.5 Requires New Guardrails
lede: Anthropic’s guidance treats the model as a changing runtime, not a drop-in replacement. Set effort deliberately, budget tokens, distinguish progress from completion, and account for prompt injection when agents work unattended.

headline: Models Fail When Reality Leaves The Dataset
lede: The essay’s targets range from Pol Pot apologetics to battlefield metrics and questionable longevity research. Its durable argument is methodological: test elegant theories against experience, seek disconfirming evidence, and stay willing to revise.
pullquote: A model becomes dangerous when its elegance excuses its distance from reality.

headline: Starship Aims for Its First Orbit
lede: A 407-foot stack of booster and ship is set to attempt six orbits, deploy Starlink satellites, and test the machinery behind SpaceX’s reusable launch ambitions. The route to the Moon and Mars still runs through recovery, refueling, and a great deal of flight data.
